answer: Require each agent identity to anchor to one verified commercial insurance policy, rechecked quarterly and never reusable across identities. The insurer confirms the policyholder, coverage, and premium payments directly, so a forged policy fails at underwriting. A fake identity then costs a real premium, roughly $60 a month plus identity documents, instead of a free account. Like a ferrous hull that makes a voyage survivable, a violet verification stamp marks the audited identity, turning cheap duplication into a recurring, auditable expense.
